recommendations: Most newsletter signup forms are protected by CAPTCHA (Mailchimp, reCAPTCHA), Cloudflare, or require full browser sessions (HubSpot hutk cookies).
The Atlantic Council is the most viable for automation: get HubSpot hutk via browser session, then submit via API.
Stars and Stripes and GZERO have valid Mailchimp endpoints but need manual CAPTCHA solving.
Sightline-based newsletters (Defense News, Military Times, CFR) all use the same JS-rendered platform with reCAPTCHA.
For Cloudflare-protected sites (7 total), browser automation with proper profile/cookies may work.
Recommend: Use browser profile with persistent cookies for Cloudflare sites, solve CAPTCHAs manually one-time per newsletter.
